events.description:
Meet the driver at the hotel entrance.
Transfer to the railway station.

Transfer to Samarkand by a high-speed train.
* please note that the departure time is not guaranteed and can be changed

Visiting the magnificent Gur-e-Amir Mausoleum (14th–15th centuries), the final resting place of the great Amir Temur (Tamerlane). Built during the Timurid era, this architectural masterpiece continues to captivate visitors from around the world with its elegance, grandeur, and stunning blue dome.
Exploring the world-famous Registan Square (15th–17th centuries), the true heart of ancient Samarkand, surrounded by the majestic Ulugbek, Tillakori, and Sherdor madrasahs — some of the finest examples of Islamic architecture in the world.

Discovering the mystical beauty of the Shah-i-Zinda Necropolis, a sacred complex of beautifully decorated mausoleums known for its dazzling mosaics and spiritual significance.
Admiring the impressive Bibi-Khanym Mosque (14th–15th centuries), once one of the grandest mosques in the Islamic world and a symbol of Amir Temur’s powerful empire.
Enjoying free time at Siyob Bazaar, the city’s most famous local market, where you can experience authentic Uzbek culture, taste traditional sweets and fresh fruits, and shop for unique souvenirs and spices.
Return to the hotel. Rest and overnight
Meet the guide at the hotel and proceed to explore Khiva.

Sightseeing in Khiva includes:
Muhammad Amin Khan Madrasa and the iconic Kalta Minor Minaret — one of the city’s most recognizable landmarks with its striking turquoise facade.
Kunya-Ark Fortress — the ancient citadel that once served as the residence of Khiva’s rulers, offering stunning views over the old city.
Muhammad Rahim Khan Madrasa — a beautiful 19th-century educational center reflecting Khiva’s cultural and scholarly heritage.
Juma Mosque (Khiva) — a unique wooden-column mosque known for its peaceful atmosphere and remarkable architectural design.
Tash Khovli Palace and the Khan’s Harem — a beautifully decorated royal residence showcasing traditional Khorezm architecture. (Approx. visit time: 40–50 minutes)
Ollaquli Khan Caravanserai — a historic trading hub that once welcomed Silk Road merchants. (Approx. visit time: 20–30 minutes)
Islam Khodja Complex — including the elegant madrasah and the tallest minaret in Khiva, offering stunning views of the old city. (Approx. visit time: 40–60 minutes)
Pahlavon Mahmud Mausoleum — a sacred and beautifully tiled complex dedicated to the city’s patron saint. (Approx. visit time: 30–40 minutes)
Local Bazaar — a vibrant market where you can experience authentic Khivan life, shop for souvenirs, and enjoy local crafts. (Approx. visit time: 30–45 minutes)

terms.serviceNote:
As travel organizers in Uzbekistan, we work with European agencies and travelers with a clear understanding of their expectations and operating standards. Flexibility, adaptability and service quality are central values for TourLink.

Our approach to hotels
We select hotels according to comfort, aesthetics, atmosphere and charm, with a preference for boutique properties. Our partner hotels are reviewed regularly, and we prioritize locations close to city centers or quiet areas suitable for rest in larger cities. Transfers in large cities are organized and included in our services.

Our approach to restaurants
Restaurants are selected according to the local character of each stop. We favor traditional establishments and coordinate menus with restaurant teams so travelers can discover the flavors of each region.

Our transport service
We provide vehicles with professional drivers and maintain regular quality control. Private guides are selected carefully and evaluated frequently to keep service standards high.

Classic and extended travel
Classic tours cover the main highlights of Uzbekistan. For longer stays, we can propose additional routes and personalized suggestions after our exchange.

data.description: Discover the magic of Uzbekistan - where vibrant culture, rich history, and breathtaking architecture come together to create an unforgettable journey. From ancient Silk Road cities to lively local bazaars, every moment is filled with beauty, flavor, and adventure. Experience the heart of Central Asia like never before.
